name: Cornelius
title: The First Gentile Christian
summary: Cornelius was a Roman officer (centurion) in the Italian cohort at Caesarea. He was devout and gave many alms. Through a vision, he was led to send for Peter, and when Peter preached, the Holy Spirit fell on all the Gentiles. This was a turning point for the spread of the gospel to non-Jews.

keyEvents.title: The Angel's Vision
keyEvents.description: Cornelius received a visit from an angel who said that his prayers and alms had risen as a memorial before God.

keyEvents.title: Peter Arrives
keyEvents.description: Peter came after his own vision about clean and unclean animals, and preached to Cornelius' household.

keyEvents.title: The Spirit Falls on the Gentiles
keyEvents.description: While Peter was speaking, the Holy Spirit fell on all the Gentiles who heard the word.
